label: early-episode a1-side (S1) commitment, suppressed by a just-seen reward
explanation: Fires only early in the episode: rate 34% in trials 0-9, 18% in 10-19, 8% in 20-29, about 0 from trial 40 and exactly 0 from trial 50. It is strongly a1/S1-sided: 90% of mass on trials where the agent picks a1 (lift 1.9x), 80% in episodes that start with S1 good, and highest at D2 when S1 is shown after a1. It is suppressed at a D1 that shows a reward (in_rew=1: rate 0.8%), so 98% of mass is on steps with no reward input. It is strongest in streaks of unrewarded a1 trials early on, and decays across consecutive rewarded a1 trials. The FUTURE predicate (ep_trial<25)&(action==1)&(in_rew==0) scores dev F1 0.56. I recorded the observed version, which swaps the upcoming action for the policy logit (choice>0) at D1/GO and the action input at D2. It scores dev F1 0.58, mass recall 0.85. Precision is only about 0.47 because many early a1 steps, especially after rewards, stay silent. Adding prev_reward==0 raises precision to 0.63 but cuts recall. It rarely fires on a2/S2 steps (rate about 1%) or late in the episode. Magnitude is largest in the first trials of the episode (ep_bucket 0-2 rate about 45%) and higher at high model value.
